name: Coforge

headline.text: Q2 FY27: revenue ₹6,171 cr (+53.7% YoY), PAT ₹605 cr (+42.4% YoY).

citations.section: Revenue Q2 FY27 not located on a page

headline.text: Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹20,380 cr, EBITDA ₹3,881 cr (19.0% margin), PAT ₹2,100 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 28.6% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹4,663 cr → ₹16,403 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 35.9% was within its 5-year range (12.4% to 37.9%).
EBITDA margin expanded by 190 bps over FY23–FY26 (16.0% → 17.9%).
PAT compounded at 30.2% a year over FY21–FY26, in line with revenue.
Debt-to-equity was 0.27 at FY27 end (0.20 at FY24).
Borrowings rose 8.3× from ₹726 cr to ₹6,026 cr over FY24–FY27.
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow was 1.13× reported profit (₹5,648 cr vs ₹4,977 cr) — profits are turning into cash.

citations.section: Operating cash flow FY26 not located on a page

claims.text: Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 5 of the last 5 years, ₹3,936 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹1,712 cr, 30% of operating cash flow (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle lengthened from 73 to 88 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 24% in FY26 (31% in FY23).

statements.quote: We had earlier mentioned that we would maintain 70% to 80% FCF to PAT.

statements.speaker: Saurabh Goel
statements.quote: But the rigor that we have brought into the organization, in terms of the way collections are being followed, the way payables are being managed, and the way contracts are being structured, gives us confidence that 100% is the bare minimum FCF to PAT we will deliver in FY27, along with the significant step-up in profitability that we mentioned in our prepared remarks.

statements.speaker: Saurabh Goel
statements.quote: It is a gradual move from not focusing on FCF to PAT, to giving guidance of 70% to 80%, delivering on that, moving to 100%, and then looking at how next year goes before probably upping it further.

statements.speaker: Kawaljeet Saluja
statements.quote: Great to see the margin focus and free cash flow guidance.

statements.speaker: Sudhir Singh
statements.quote: Equally importantly, on the margin front, it is pertinent to note that our reported 13.4 % EBIT for the quarter and our plan to register a 15% EBIT in Q4 will lead us to the 14% EBIT guidance for FY2026.

statements.speaker: Sudhir Singh
statements.quote: Finally, free cash flow for the quarter came in at 110%, significantly ahead of our guidance of around 70% to 80% FCF on a sustained basis.
